{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g is missing
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Verify the drop
print('Rows after dropping missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g:', len(penguins_clean))

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

print('Pearson correlation:', correlation)"}
